survival.name: Survival
survival.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Search gives +2 to follow tracks. 5+ ranks in Knowledge (nature/dungeoneering/the planes) gives +2 in respective environments.

actions.name: Forage for Food and Fresh Water
actions.description: Feed and water yourself in wilderness terrain over a day without expending rations.

actions.name: Follow Tracks and Trail Spoor
actions.description: Discern hoofprints, bent twigs, and scents to track quarry across rugged terrain (requires Track feat).

actions.name: Survive Severe Weather and Environmental Hazards
actions.description: Shelter allies against hypothermia, sandstorms, thin air, or scorching heat.
